entities.name: Fysmatan
entities.description: Coastal city-state on the Sea of Serenity in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Lucrezia
entities.description: Rival city of Fysmatan ruled by a Princess.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Robaran Mercenaries who served the Shah of Fysmatan.

entities.name: Shah of Fysmatan
entities.description: Ruler of Fysmatan who hired Adira.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Warlord whose war menaced Jamuraa's coastal cities.

events.summary: Adira and the Robaran Mercenaries serve the Shah of Fysmatan against Lucrezia.
events.quote: Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries served under the Shah of Fysmatan, since he offered them a greater share of the bounty than Lucrezia.

events.summary: Adira incites a revolt of the Lucrezia slaves, steals the war fleet and sells it to the Shah.
events.quote: Adira inflicted a heavy blow against the Lucrezia marines, inciting a revolt against their slave, stealing their war fleet, and selling the ships to the Sha of Fysmatan

relations.quote: Fysmatan was frequently at war with a rival city, Lucrezia
